G.disappearance_rule: own 3000-step L2 frame center >= 0.65 and switched 6000-step frame center < 0.65

texture_method.blur: separable discrete Gaussian, sigma=3 pixels, radius=12 (4 sigma)
texture_method.normalization: subtract spatial mean; divide by population SD over all 64x64 pixels before overlay
texture_method.sharing: one new pattern per sample, shared by both frames and by input/target
texture_method.white_noise: NumPy Generator.standard_normal float32, independent SeedSequence child 3

H.psnr_reference: the clean image including the sample's fixed background texture
H.texture_sd_definition: population SD over the entire 64x64 background before circle overlay
